windy.config.title: Windy: Configurable Settings
windy.config.spawnRateMultiplier.desc: 1.0 = original Windy default spawn rate, 0.5 = half as many, 2.0 = twice as many, 0.0 = off
windy.config.advancedJsonNote: All Windy settings can be edited from this screen.
windy.config.spawnWind.tooltip: Controls whether Windy spawns wind particles at all.
windy.config.windMustSeeSky.tooltip: When enabled, wind particles only spawn where the position can see the sky.
windy.config.windDensityMode.tooltip: Constant uses one height and multiplier everywhere. Y-Level Scaling gradually changes the spawn multiplier between the configured minimum and maximum heights.
Lowest Y level where wind can spawn while Constant density mode is active. Range: -64 to 320.
windy.config.constant.spawnRateMultiplie: Particle density while Constant mode is active. 1.0 is the original Windy rate, 0.5 is half, 2.0 is double, and 0.0 disables spawning. Range: 0 to 100.
windy.config.scaling.minimumWindHeight.t: Lowest Y level where wind can spawn while Y-Level Scaling is active. Range: -64 to 320.
windy.config.scaling.minimumSpawnRateMul: Particle density at the minimum wind height. Range: 0 to 100.
windy.config.scaling.maximumWindHeight.t: Y level where the maximum spawn multiplier is reached. Above this height the maximum multiplier is kept. Range: -64 to 320.
windy.config.scaling.maximumSpawnRateMul: Particle density at and above the maximum wind height. Range: 0 to 100.
windy.config.biomeWindEnabled.tooltip: Applies the blacklist and biome multipliers below on top of the selected wind density mode.
windy.config.biomeBlacklist.tooltip: Comma-separated biome IDs or biome tags that should spawn no wind. Example: minecraft:deep_dark, #minecraft:is_nether
windy.config.biomeMultipliers.tooltip: Comma-separated biome or tag multipliers in key=value form. Example: #minecraft:is_ocean=1.5, minecraft:desert=0.6. Blacklist entries win; exact biome IDs override tags; if multiple tags match, the highest multiplier is used.
